build_masked_temporal_pooling: build a MaskedTemporalPooling module to apply max, avg, or sum pooling on masked sequence tensors
create_transpose_multihead_attention: create a TransposeMultiheadAttention module to apply multihead attention on batched sequence tensors with masking
build_masked_sequential: build a MaskedSequential container to compose masked modules like attention, pooling, and LSTM in sequence
create_masked_lstm: create a masked LSTM wrapper that processes variable-length sequences using pack_padded_sequence
